bill_notes: Admitted 2026-09-12 through the emergency department after being hit by a car. Discharged 2026-09-14. Insurer denied the claim for missing prior authorization. Hospital chart shows one CT scan.

answer_key.explain: CT scan billed twice; the chart shows one CT scan.
Admitted Sep 12, discharged Sep 14 is 2 nights, but 3 nights are billed.
Emergency care generally cannot require prior authorization, so a denial for missing prior authorization is likely wrong.
answer_key.fix: Appeal the denial with the insurer and ask the hospital to rebill; confirm with the insurer

answer_key.explain: An out-of-network anesthesia group at an in-network hospital often cannot balance-bill beyond in-network cost sharing.
